_meta.phase: Phase 7B.4.1 — FIXEO Electricity Human Calibration & Fair-Price Policy
_meta.ai_claim_note: Current system = RULE_BASED_LOOKUP at LEVEL_0. 'FIXEO AI Price' and equivalent claims PROHIBITED.
_meta.price_provenance_description: FIXEO human-calibrated pilot price based on aggregated Moroccan market research and dual-fairness economic review.

canonical_doctrines.dual_fairness_principle: A FIXEO price is acceptable only if it simultaneously protects the client from arbitrary overpricing AND the artisan from economically unsustainable underpricing. A FIXEO electricity price must additionally NEVER create an economic incentive for the artisan to bypass a safety issue to remain inside the fixed-price scope.
canonical_doctrines.electrical_safety_override: FIXEO_ELECTRICAL_SAFETY_OVERRIDE: When the artisan discovers a condition that makes the intervention unsafe, materially different, or outside the standardized scope: STOP → MAKE SAFE → EXPLAIN → DECLARE HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → NO SILENT INCREASE → QUOTE → APPROVE → CONTINUE.
canonical_doctrines.hors_perimetre_workflow: STOP → MAKE SAFE → IDENTIFY → EXPLAIN → DECLARE → QUOTE → APPROVE → CONTINUE. Client retains right to decline and pay only 200 MAD diagnostic fee.
canonical_doctrines.diagnostic_absorption_rule: If client accepts a qualifying standardized FIXEO repair during the SAME visit, the 200 MAD diagnostic fee is ABSORBED into the intervention price. Client must NOT pay diagnostic + full intervention price for same-visit standard repair.
canonical_doctrines.materials_canonical: FIXEO standardized electrical price = LABOUR + TRAVEL + SMALL CONSUMABLES ONLY. Major component (prise, interrupteur, MCB, luminaire) = EXCLUDED. Client-supplied by default, OR artisan-supplied with explicit disclosure + client approval before installation.
canonical_doctrines.onee_boundary: The disjoncteur de branchement (limiteur de puissance) is ONEE property. NEVER included in any FIXEO electrical scope. If it is the faulty component, redirect client to ONEE (0801 00 20 20).
canonical_doctrines.earth_policy_core: An installation cannot be represented as compliant when earth continuity is absent or defective. SAFETY_OVERRIDE required if earth circuit is absent from cable run, damaged, or incorrectly bonded.
canonical_doctrines.multiple_item_policy: Standardized FIXEO price applies to ONE item per call-out. Multi-item batch work requires a separately defined batch-price model (future phase). FIXEO must not imply single-item prices multiply linearly for batch work.
canonical_doctrines.no_urgency_modifiers: urgency_modifier = null. Night/weekend/holiday modifiers = null. Legacy FIXEO values (+40%/+25%/+20%/+15%) NON-CANONICAL. Future disclaimer: 'Interventions en soirée et week-end : majoration possible — tarif artisan prévalent.'
canonical_doctrines.no_city_multipliers: city_adjustment = null. National pilot prices only. afous.ma coefficients documented as research context only — FIXEO cannot adopt without own transaction data.

artisan_economic_model.note: 100 MAD = absolute minimum viability guard. NOT the target. Electricity work carries tool capital costs — economics should materially exceed the 100 MAD floor.

proposed_pilot_prices_summary.note_on_interrupteur: Two options proposed for simple interrupteur: 200 MAD (floor breach at 20%+HIGH fuel) or 220 MAD (all scenarios clear). Human decision required. Recommendation: 220 MAD.

floor_breach_summary.interrupteur_simple_200_note: Floor breach ONLY at 20% commission + HIGH_60 fuel (90 MAD net < 100 MAD). Resolved by raising to 220 MAD.

market_reference.basis: mano.ma 200-500 DH (diagnostic+research); afous.ma 150-180 DH/h hourly (480 relevés). Diagnostic-only anchor: 200-300 DH.

scope_included: Standard travel within normal urban intervention zone
Initial on-site electrical inspection (visual + basic measurements)
Voltage verification, continuity check, circuit identification
Fault identification attempt without invasive work
Verbal explanation of findings
Verbal repair quote if applicable
Safety observations communicated (earth wire status noted)
scope_excluded: Extensive circuit tracing beyond accessible components
Specialist equipment (thermal camera, megohmmeter, power quality analyser)
Full tableau audit or compliance assessment
Written diagnostic report or electrical certification

diagnostic_policy.absorption_condition: Fee absorbed if client accepts qualifying same-visit standardized repair (prise, interrupteur, luminaire, confirmed single MCB). Client does NOT pay 200 MAD + full intervention price.
diagnostic_policy.payable_when: No repair performed; scope requires new quote; fault inconclusive; ONEE equipment involved; specialist equipment required; safety override triggered.

calibration_candidates.onee_policy: If fault is in ONEE-controlled equipment: 200 MAD charged. Redirect client to ONEE. FIXEO cannot resolve.
calibration_candidates.safety_note: Findings may reveal dangerous conditions → SAFETY_OVERRIDE → communicate + refer.
complexity_escape_rules: Address outside normal urban zone → travel supplement quote
Specialist equipment required (thermal camera, megohmmeter) → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → specialist diagnostic
ONEE-controlled equipment fault → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → redirect to ONEE
Intermittent fault cannot be reproduced → diagnostic inconclusive → 200 MAD charged
Safety override triggered → make safe → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → separate safety remediation
calibration_candidates.client_disclosure: Frais de déplacement et diagnostic : 200 MAD. Ce montant est dû même si vous ne procédez pas à la réparation. Si une réparation FIXEO standard est réalisée lors de la même visite, le diagnostic est inclus dans le prix de l'intervention.
calibration_candidates.artisan_disclosure: Prix FIXEO diagnostic électrique : 200 MAD. Si le client accepte immédiatement une réparation FIXEO standard lors de la même visite, le diagnostic est absorbé dans le prix de l'intervention — ne facturez pas les deux séparément.

onee_boundary.disjoncteur_de_branchement: ABSOLUTELY EXCLUDED — ONEE property, sealed. Never touch. If client identifies this as the fault: redirect to ONEE (0801 00 20 20).
onee_boundary.identification_guide: ONEE disjoncteur de branchement: typically separate sealed unit, branded ONEE/LYDEC/RADEEF, below or adjacent to meter, has utility seal. Private MCBs: DIN-rail mounted, in client's tableau, 1P/2P modular, no seal.

mandatory_conditions_to_proceed: MCB is physically defective (broken toggle, cracked housing, non-latching, burnt internal) — confirmed on arrival
Private residential distribution board — standard modular MCBs
Accessible tableau — no ONEE-sealed components involved
Replacement MCB specification verified as appropriate (current rating, type match)
No burnt smell, scorch marks, or tableau overheating
No evidence of downstream fault on the circuit
diagnostic_first_required_when: Breaker trips immediately on reset — downstream fault likely
Breaker trips repeatedly without clear cause
Burning smell or scorch marks visible in tableau
Client cannot identify which circuit the breaker controls

scope_included: Standard travel within normal urban intervention zone
Visual inspection of distribution board on arrival
Confirmation that MCB replacement is warranted (defective MCB verified)
Safety isolation: turn off downstream circuits, verify dead
Labour: remove defective MCB from DIN rail
Labour: install client-supplied replacement MCB of correct specification
Labour: reconnect load conductors
Functional test: reset, verify circuit restored, MCB holds under normal load
Post-installation: brief visual check of tableau for other obvious anomalies
scope_excluded: Interrupteur différentiel (DDR/RCD) — different part, higher cost
Investigation of tripping cause (→ diagnostic service)

materials_policy.client_label: Main-d'œuvre + déplacement — disjoncteur fourni par le client
materials_policy.client_guidance: Identifiez le calibre du disjoncteur (ex : 16A, 20A, 32A, 1P ou 2P) et achetez un disjoncteur de remplacement de même calibre chez un grossiste électrique. Marques recommandées : Schneider, Legrand, ABB, Hager.
materials_policy.safety_part_note: Artisan must never install an uncertified generic breaker. If artisan supplies: certified brand only (Schneider, Legrand, ABB, Hager), declared separately, client approval required before installation.

diagnostic_policy.when_included: MCB physically defective confirmed on arrival without investigation — proceed directly.
diagnostic_policy.when_diagnostic_first: Cause uncertain, repeated tripping, or unknown downstream fault — book diagnostic first (200 MAD).
diagnostic_policy.absorption: If diagnostic confirms single defective MCB and client accepts immediate replacement: diagnostic fee absorbed into 250 MAD disjoncteur service.

mandatory_safety_checks: Turn off all downstream circuits before working on panel
Verify main incoming supply cannot be inadvertently energized during work
Do NOT work on live busbars
Verify replacement MCB specification matches original (voltage, current rating, trip curve, breaking capacity)
Test after installation before closing tableau

commission_sensitivity.note: Strongest economics of the five — no consumables, no part cost. Safety premium justified.

complexity_escape_rules: Breaker trips immediately on reset → DIAGNOSTIC_FIRST → downstream fault investigation
Burning smell or scorch marks in tableau → SAFETY_OVERRIDE → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
Busbar damaged/overheated/corroded → SAFETY_OVERRIDE → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → tableau assessment quote
Multiple MCBs defective → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → full tableau assessment quote
DDR/RCD is the component needing replacement → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → DDR installation quote
Three-phase circuit → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → specialist quote
ONEE disjoncteur de branchement identified → REDIRECT TO ONEE (0801 00 20 20)
Replacement MCB specification cannot be verified → pause → consult before proceeding
Wiring behind MCB burnt/oversized/undersized → SAFETY_OVERRIDE → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
calibration_candidates.client_disclosure: Prix FIXEO : 250 MAD — main-d'œuvre et déplacement. Le disjoncteur est fourni par le client (même calibre que l'original). Service valable uniquement si le disjoncteur est physiquement défectueux. Si le disjoncteur saute de façon répétée, un diagnostic préalable (200 MAD) est nécessaire.
calibration_candidates.artisan_disclosure: Prix FIXEO remplacement disjoncteur : 250 MAD — main-d'œuvre seule. Client fournit le disjoncteur (calibre identique). Ne jamais intervenir sur le disjoncteur de branchement ONEE. Si le disjoncteur saute immédiatement au réenclenchement : déclarer hors périmètre et proposer le service de diagnostic.
